title: Daily English Dictation 1
sentence: Mother Teresa, who received a Nobel Peace Prize for her work on behalf of the poor, dies in Calcutta, India—she was 87 years old.

vocab.phonetic: /ɑːn bɪˈhæf əv/ → on behalf of 连读，of 弱读成 /əv/

takeaways:
用现在时 dies（而非常规过去时 died）：AP 历史回顾采用“历史现在时”（historical present），仿佛事件正在发生。
定语从句：who received a Nobel Peace Prize... 修饰 Mother Teresa。
短语：on behalf of = 代表 / 为了……的利益（也可说 for）。
辅音+元音相连时要连读（received a、for her、behalf of）
弱读：of、for、her 常弱化为 /əv/、/fər/、/ər/
快速语流中不要每个词都咬死，要有节奏感
